01About

Engineer by craft, educator by calling

I am a Design Verification Engineer at NXP Semiconductors in Austin, Texas, where I work on DMA based IP for automotive SoCs. My days are spent in UVM based IP verification, SystemVerilog assertions, CDC verification and memory error injection.

My independent research brings AI into verification, from smarter regressions to assertions that write themselves. Beyond the lab, I speak on international stages, review for IEEE journals, judge industry awards, and run SiliconDV, an open education platform that has grown into a community of more than 10,000 verification engineers and students.

05 · Founder · silicondv.com

SiliconDV: open education for verification engineers

I founded SiliconDV to make hardware verification learnable for everyone. The platform runs AXI, CDC, UVM and SystemVerilog series alongside DV career roadmaps and mentoring, free and open to all.
